name: Veo 3.1 Lite Preview
description: High-efficiency, developer-first video model providing video generation, editing, and cinematic control at the best Veo 3.1 prices for high-volume applications. Does not support 4K output or video extension. Shuts down on October 22, 2026; the recommended replacement is Gemini Omni Flash.
